name: Krita
description: A free and open source digital painting application.
summary: Krita has a moratorium on AI tools in development because its community has not reached consensus; until a decision is made, using AI when working on Krita is not allowed. The moratorium was set to run until October 2026.

evidence.quote: Until we make a decision, the use of AI when working on Krita is not allowed.
we have decided to put a moratorium on the use of these tools until October 2026.
